Mumbai • +91- 9535252294 • tapsalesneha14@gmail.com • https:// www.linkedin.com/in/stapsale
Achievement Driven and result oriented Business Analyst with 5 years of experience in Business Analysis, Process Re-engineering, and Project Management,Vision & Strategy. Expertise in Requirements Gathering, Gap Analysis, User Stories, and Test Cases
raw_sections.experience:
Experience, with working experience across US, APAC, Europe, and Middle East markets. Adept at collaborating with cross functional teams and aligning business objectives with technology solutions to drive business growth, maximize operational efficiency, and ensure regulatory compliance. Industries: BSFI, IT Services & Consulting.
WORK EXPERIENCE DEUTSCHE BANK, Bangalore. Business Analyst :-
July 2021-Oct 2025
Managed and prioritized the product backlog in JIRA, collaborating with Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, Data Architects, and Technology teams to Refine requirements, Facilitate backlog grooming, Sprint planning, and ensure traceable delivery aligned with governance and control standards.
Documented user stories with acceptance criteria, BRDs, business value, and preconditions. Performed AS-IS and TO-BE gap analysis, contributed to the design of the Target Operating Model (TOM), and delivered fit-for-business solutions by defining change strategies to support process transformation and business objectives. Hands-on experience across Investment Banking, Capital Markets, and Cross-Border Payments with exposure to ISO 20022 migration, SWIFT MT/MX messaging (PAIN.001, PACS.008, PACS.009, MT103, MT202), Fedwire, SEPA, and payment processing. Knowledge of Trade Lifecycle and Capital Market products including Equities and Bonds..
Coordinated Agile delivery activities including Capacity planning, sprint scope management, UAT support, Program implementation readiness, and cross-functional stakeholder communication to improve delivery predictability mitigate risks, and ensure successful project execution.
Organized & Led Requirement Gathering (Elicitation) meetings using techniques like Interviews, Questionnaires, Document Analysis and Focus Group Discussions.
Collaborated with team during development, Integration Testing, Functional Testing, and UAT to deliver end-to-end solution. • Designed and executed SIT/UAT test cases, API workflow including initiation, authorization, Acknowledgement for functional clarification and system integration. Involved in creating wireframes and mockups/Prototypes for the system using MSVISIO.
Managed test scenarios for success/Failure cases of customer operation and live Payment transaction for successful Job to be done.
Leveraged Generative AI(Gen AI) tools including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and OpenAI Codex to accelerate business analysis, automate documentation, generate user stories and improve stakeholder communication and productivity.
Ensure team adherence to all quality of processing as maintained in SLA, compliance to release for production. • Monitored delivery performance through KPI reporting, change management metrics, dependency tracking, and production issue resolution, driving continuous process improvements and ensuring timely remediation of defects and operational risks. • Performed Business Capability Mapping and contributed to Operating Model Design by defining the Future
Operating Model, identifying capability gaps, and recommending target-state processes to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.
Eteam Info service Private limited, Pune. • Handling key corporate partnership. • Customer relationship management corporate. • Managing the schedules with constant tie-ups major branches of banks and implementing sale promotional strategies. • Coordinate with operation staff for providing fast customer services. • Managing multiple branches of banks and generating business. • Business analysis, Risk analysis.
Dec 2020-july 2021
